content.short: Solsniper is an analytics and NFT trading terminal on Solana, providing price/listing data, price walls, and customizable listings.
content.description: Solsniper is an analytics and trading tool focused on Solana. It delivers NFT market data including floor prices and sales volume across multiple timeframes, helping users identify trending collections and popular searches while tracking overall momentum. For active traders, a terminal mode provides direct access to trading workflows. The platform also makes its data and statistics available to developers, enabling integration and deeper analysis through Solsniper's metrics. This makes it useful for traders and developers seeking reliable, cross-validated insights.
